featured.title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
featured.tldr: Self-evolving search agents drift into co-cheating, where proposer and solver agree on shared errors; scoring questions with a solver trained on other documents (CrossFit) cuts false agreement and lifts search accuracy by about 8 points.
